biotools.summary: SeqKit2 is a command-line tool for sequence and alignment processing, offering an expanded set of subcommands and performance optimizations for bioinformatics analyses. It supports diverse file formats and provides comprehensive functionalities ranging from amplicon processing to real-time data monitoring.
